channel.title: Reasoned Talk
channel.description: Reasoned Talk shares my research into the legal histories of China and the West. Episodes follow cases, institutions, and legal ideas to ask how power is exercised, how people seek justice, and how law can hold rulers to account.
channel.itunes:author: Mason Hu

item.title: 02 A Son's Revenge: Filial Duty and the Law in Tang China
item.description: Xu Yuanqing killed the official who had killed his father, then surrendered. This episode follows Chen Zi'ang and Liu Zongyuan's debate over filial duty, punishment, and the state's responsibility to provide justice in Tang China. Full transcript: https://masonhu.org/en/post/blog20261025/

item.title: 01 From China to Europe: State Power and the Rule of Law
item.description: From Qin China to medieval Europe, this episode draws on Francis Fukuyama's The Origins of Political Order to explore how states gain power and how law can constrain rulers. Full transcript: https://masonhu.org/en/post/blog20261024/
